summary: President Trump announced the US Navy has cleared or detonated all mines from international waters of the Strait of Hormuz, with zero-tolerance policy enforced against any new mine-laying. IDF and Shin Bet conducted strikes destroying five Hamas weapons storage sites and a launch site in Gaza, including facilities located within mosques and beside humanitarian infrastructure. Iranian Deputy Foreign Minister Gharibabadi confirmed an agreement with Oman on Hormuz passage routes and indicated Iran seeks full US compliance with memoranda of understanding.
key_points: Trump stated all mines were removed or detonated from international waters of the Strait of Hormuz, with Iran notified that any vessel laying new mines will be immediately and systematically destroyed. (Source: @inon_yttach/9947)

IDF and Shin Bet struck and destroyed five Hamas weapons storage sites and one launch site across multiple strikes in the Gaza Strip, where rockets, weapons, explosives, grenades and additional combat equipment were stored. (Source: @almogboker78/18052)

The IDF Chief of General Staff completed a visit to the Gaza Strip, meeting fighting forces and conducting a situation assessment with commanders in the sector amid ongoing operations. (Source: @inon_yttach/9943)

Iranian Deputy Foreign Minister Gharibabadi confirmed the entry route to the Persian Gulf passes through Iran's waters while the exit route uses Oman's territorial waters, with ships transiting both routes through Iran under the agreement with Oman. (Source: @presstv/204185)
Initial reports from Lebanon indicate an air strike targeted a location in the Shiite village of al-Mansouri in the south of the country. (Source: @yediotnews25/134310)
Trump's administration transmitted a civilian nuclear cooperation agreement with Saudi Arabia to Congress, according to a senior US administration official cited by Reuters. (Source: @N12chat/223542)

Israeli Eilat border forces are preparing to counter potential terrorist infiltrations and hostage scenarios from multiple directions including Yemen, Iran, and Jordan amid increasing regional threats. (Source: @inon_yttach/9945)

sections.executive_summary: President Trump announced complete mine clearance from Strait of Hormuz international waters with zero-tolerance enforcement against new deployments. IDF and Shin Bet destroyed five Hamas weapons storage sites and a launch site in Gaza, with facilities embedded within mosques and civilian infrastructure. Iranian officials confirmed Hormuz passage arrangements with Oman while Turkey's Erdogan warned against Israeli actions in Syria. Tanker tracking operations documented 15+ ship-to-ship transfers moving approximately 25 million barrels of crude oil in the Gulf of Oman.

sections.threat_assessment: The Strait of Hormuz remains a critical flashpoint with US forces having completed mine clearance operations and establishing zero-tolerance enforcement posture. The IDF operations in Gaza indicate sustained offensive posture against Hamas infrastructure, with weapons storage sites increasingly embedded in civilian structures creating escalation potential. The reported air strike in southern Lebanon suggests Israeli operations may be expanding beyond Gaza. Iran's confirmed Hormuz agreement with Oman indicates diplomatic channels remain active despite military tensions. Multi-directional threat assessments for Israeli border positions from Yemen, Iran, and Jordan continue to elevate regional threat levels.
sections.regional_response: Turkey's Erdogan issued strong warnings against actors attempting bloody scenarios in Syria while affirming support for regional brothers, indicating deepening Turkish involvement in Syrian dynamics. Iran's diplomatic efforts through Pakistani intermediaries and Omani mediation suggest Tehran is pursuing negotiated outcomes while maintaining military pressure capabilities. The Saudi-US nuclear cooperation agreement transmission to Congress signals potential strategic realignment in Gulf security architecture. Regional actors appear to be calibrating responses between diplomatic engagement and military readiness.
sections.intelligence_notes: The timing of IDF Chief's Gaza visit coinciding with expanded operations against Hamas infrastructure suggests intensified offensive campaign. Iranian statements about the Hormuz closure achieving their pre-negotiation demands indicate Tehran may view current developments as favorable outcome. Live monitoring of southern Lebanon airspace indicates potential for expanded Israeli operations. The volume of ship-to-ship oil transfers (25 million barrels across 15+ operations) demonstrates commercial shipping continues routing through Gulf of Oman despite military tensions, with tanker trackers actively documenting these operations.
